mainEntity.name: Why does preparation of documentation matter at the filing stage?

acceptedAnswer.text: It matters because Brazil immigration work usually turns on how well the documents support the facts, not only on whether a person believes they qualify. Before the next step, preparation of documentation usually has to be checked for delay, inconsistency, and procedural risk as much as for the legal rule itself.

mainEntity.name: Why does review and verification matter at the filing stage?

acceptedAnswer.text: It matters because clients usually need the topic translated into practical terms before they can decide what to do with it.
